entities.summary: Mollā Moḥammad bin Mortezā bin Maḥmūd Kāshānī, known as Mollā Moḥsen Fayz Kāshānī was an Iranian Akhbari Twelver Shi'i Muslim, mystic, poet, philosopher, and muhaddith.
